svg.title: Figure 05 · A three-instrument bootstrap
svg.desc: Synthetic annual par instruments generated from continuous zero rates of 2%, 2.5% and 3%. Connecting discount nodes requires an interpolation choice; input repricing alone does not determine intermediate forwards.
